problem.description: Intermittent ESC system shutdown on highway driving after 3000 km; customer reported loss of stability control warning and chime.

is_is_not.is: Intermittent shutdown (signal loss) of ESC control module after 3000-5000 km operation on highway driving.
is_is_not.is_not: Physical module failure, connector looseness, or software crash (logs show clean state transition).
is_is_not.observed_effect: ESC warning lamp illuminates; chime sounds; steering assist disabled for 2-5 seconds; then recovery to normal operation.
is_is_not.impact: Customer safety concern; potential warranty claim; risk of fleet return.

interim_containment.action: Implement CAN message watchdog timeout alert in firmware (non-critical warning only)
interim_containment.verification: Deployed in ECU v1.2.3; field validation on 10 customer vehicles

interim_containment.action: Issue technical bulletin to service centers: restart ESC module if warning appears; check CAN termination resistors.
interim_containment.verification: TB-2026-447 published and distributed to all dealers

root_causes.cause: CAN bus termination resistor missing or disconnected at ECU connector (contact corrosion after thermal cycling).
root_causes.evidence: Oscilloscope trace shows CAN ringing (underdamped) at module startup; resistance measurement at connector pin shows >50k ohm (should be <0.1 ohm).
root_causes.contributing_factors: Thermal cycling during summer operation; connector pin plating thickness below spec (plating lot issue, supplier quality); no electrical continuity test in production assembly.

corrective_actions.action: Upgrade connector pins to gold-plated specification (supplier contract revision); increase plating thickness from 0.5 um to 2 um.
corrective_actions.verification_method: X-ray fluorescence (XRF) thickness check on first production lot

corrective_actions.action: Add electrical continuity test (CAN termination resistance) to in-circuit test (ICT) program at assembly station.
corrective_actions.verification_method: ICT program validation with engineering sample vehicles

corrective_actions.action: Release firmware v1.2.4 with enhanced CAN error recovery and diagnostic logging.
corrective_actions.verification_method: Hardware-in-loop (HIL) testing; field trial on 20 customer vehicles

prevention.description: Implement automated CAN termination resistance test into production ICT; set alarm threshold at >5 ohm.
Update supplier quality agreement with pin plating thickness requirement (2.0-2.5 um Au over Ni); increase incoming inspection to 100% XRF sampling.
Review connector design for next generation; evaluate shielded/filtered CAN connectors to reduce EMI and contact stress.
Conduct cross-functional training on CAN bus signal integrity and connector quality; include in design review checklist.
